COMPUTER NETWORKS
Engineering Course Syllabus

UNIT - I Data Communication and Computer Networks

Data Communication and Networks:
Representation of data communication, flow of
Networks, Transmission Media. (William stalling)., Multiplexing - Frequency division, Switching techniques

Physical Layer and Transmission:
Guided transmission media, wireless transmission, circuit switching and packet switching

UNIT - II Data Link Layer and Local Area Networks

Framing and Error Control:
Framing techniques, error detection codes, error correction methods

Medium Access Control:
ALOHA protocols, CSMA/CD, token ring and token bus protocols

Local Area Networks:
Ethernet standards, wireless LAN fundamentals, VLAN concepts

UNIT - III Network Layer and Routing

Routing Algorithms:
Distance vector routing, link state routing, hierarchical routing schemes

IPv4 Addressing:
Classful addressing, subnetting, CIDR notation and supernetting

IPv6 and Transition:
IPv6 header format, transition mechanisms, dual stack deployment

Network Layer Services:
Datagram networks, virtual circuit networks, congestion control overview

UNIT - IV Transport Layer Protocols

TCP Protocol:
TCP segment structure, connection establishment, flow control and reliability

UDP and Sockets:
UDP datagram structure, socket programming basics, transport layer multiplexing

UNIT - V Application Layer Services

Web and Email Protocols:
HTTP methods, SMTP fundamentals, MIME and multipart messages

Application Security:
DNS security themes, email threats, web application security overview
